description: Twenty synthetic authored cases, not production data or a representative benchmark. Five sequential rounds yield 100 uncached provider evaluations. These cases test explicit news/commit attribution and hypothetical snapshot classification rules, never market recommendations or execution.
interpretation: Acceptance is exact choice equality, noul>=0.5 for true (otherwise false), and inclusive score bands. The default decision policy is preserved; accepted/needs_review is recorded independently. Scores use a declared ordinal 0..2 rubric, not real-world urgency.
